title: Vlan class id remains unaffected after 1 subport is removed
author: neethajohn
body:
Steps
* Select 1 subport and remove it 
(Remove all entries associated with that subintf from VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE table (there will be 3 keys - subintf, subintf |ip addr , subintf | ipv6 addr).
*  Send traffic between other subports 

Expected result:
Traffic forwarding between other subports should work fine
